title: RegNav Source Watch
description: Track source changes and identify affected research, policy and governance claims in GitHub pull requests. Dependency-free evidence review Action. This deposit preserves a dated source snapshot of the implementation and documentation, with the limitations stated in the repository.
notes: Apache-2.0 applies to this project only. The tool detects recorded changes; it does not establish legal or factual truth or authenticate human review. Archival publication does not establish peer review, independent validation or production readiness.
